parts.name: Blade Handle Set
parts.Basic_description: This part consists of one blade and one handle of the scissors, made of stainless steel for the blade and plastic for the handle.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as one half of the cutting mechanism and provides a grip for the user to apply force.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the screw pivot to open and close against the other blade handle set.

parts.name: Blade Handle Set
parts.Basic_description: This is the second blade and handle assembly of the scissors, also made of stainless steel and plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It forms the complementary half of the cutting pair, working with the first blade to shear materials.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots around the screw to move in opposition to the first blade handle set, enabling cutting action.

parts.name: Screw
parts.Basic_description: A small steel screw that connects the two blade handle sets at the pivot point.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the two halves together and allows them to rotate smoothly around the pivot.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed in place while allowing rotational movement of the two blade handle sets around it.
